ReviewComment.description: One finding: where it is, what is wrong, what it rests on, what to do.

category.description: What kind of problem, lower_snake_case (the review skill lists them).
category.title: Category

claim.description: What is wrong, in one or two sentences.
claim.title: Claim

evidence.description: What the claim rests on, quoted: 'path:line text' (a spec or code line), 'path:start-end text' or 'model:<key> text'. Mandatory.
evidence.title: Evidence

file.description: Repo-relative file the comment is on.
file.title: File

line.description: Line in the new version of `file`, inside the diff.
line.title: Line

req_id.description: The requirement id the comment is about, if any.
req_id.title: Req Id

ReviewComment.title: ReviewComment

description: A review task's reply: what was reviewed, the comments, the verdict.

base.description: The base ref of the diff, as given.
base.title: Base

comments.description: The findings; empty means no findings.
comments.title: Comments

head.description: The head ref of the diff, as given.
head.title: Head

reviewed.description: Repo-relative files looked at; every file of the diff when no comments.
reviewed.title: Reviewed

summary.description: One short paragraph: what changed and the verdict's reason.
summary.title: Summary

target.description: What was reviewed (the block), as given.
target.title: Target

title: ReviewReport
